body:
incident-bot: ALERT: P1 - Node infer-edge-03 (us-west-2) -> NotReady (kubelet restart). Affected: inference-pool-edge-usw. Link: https://ops.redwood/incident/6555554444
alex_oncall: ack. Investigating. @sara_sre are you oncall?
sara_sre: oncall here, seeing 502s from gateway and pod evictions in the pool. Customers: onboarding-api, search-embeddings noticed.
mike_infra: kubelet restarted 3x in last 2m on infer-edge-03. pulling logs.
alex_oncall: running quick check:
```bash
$ kubectl get nodes infer-edge-03 -o wide
NAME            STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION
infer-edge-03   NotReady   <none>   24d   v1.25.8
```
ingrid_prod: Telemetry: inference_gateway 95p latency went from 1.1s -> 2.5s, error rate x4 in last 5m.
mike_infra: journal snippet:
```text
Mar 17 10:02:14 infer-edge-03 kubelet[1234]: E03017 10:02:14 ... runtime service runtimeApi failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = connection refused
Mar 17 10:02:15 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 8765 (python) score 1200 or sacrifice child
Mar 17 10:02:16 nvidia: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
```
ops-bot: Auto-scale: provisioning 2 nodes to inference-dedicated-usw (requested by policy: node-loss)
alex_oncall: Plan: cordon + drain infer-edge-03, scale up +2 (ops-bot doing), route inference-gateway to fallback variant small-model for 10m, monitor metrics. Who can run cordon/drain?
mike_infra: running now:
```bash
$ kubectl cordon infer-edge-03
node "infer-edge-03" cordoned
$ kubectl drain infer-edge-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
evicting pod inference-gateway-abcde
pod inference-worker-12345 evicted
```
sara_sre: CS update: I'll notify affected customers with ~15m ETA and note no data retention impact. posting to status.redwood.io
ingrid_prod: note: nvidia-smi shows driver died before OOM message:
```text
$ nvidia-smi
NVIDIA-SMI has failed because it couldn't communicate with the NVIDIA driver. Make sure that the latest NVIDIA driver is installed and running.
```
ops-bot: scale up complete: 2 new nodes join pool (infer-edge-08, infer-edge-09)
alex_oncall: Drain complete, pods rescheduled to new nodes. Observability: 95p latency back to ~1.2s, error rate dropping.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity -> P2. No ongoing customer-impacting errors detected for last 2m.
lina_cs: status page updated and customers notified :thumbsup:
sara_sre: handoff to morning oncall @ingrid_prod for RCA and driver/kernel investigation. I'll open postmortem and link.
ingrid_prod: ack handoff. I'll capture dmesg + driver versions and add timeline. Closing chat unless further alerts.
alex_oncall: thanks all, good work.
